videos.desc: A flower-market worker finds her flowers dumped in a bag on the table and boils over: she grabs her head, hurls the bag down, kicks a bucket across the empty hall and stands over the flowers shaking with clenched fists.

A cartoon man in a purple tracksuit waits in a laundromat and slowly loses his mind from boredom: he watches the clock, balances stacked cups on his head, blows a feather, spins his laundry bag on one finger, slides off his chair and ends up wearing a wet sock on his head.

A street musician plays the accordion in a tiled subway underpass while commuters walk past without giving anything. He bends over his instrument case, finds it completely empty, sighs, and ends up slumped on the floor of the long empty tunnel, hopeless.

A bearded man in a teal raincoat waits excitedly at a street food stand, rubbing his hands, and receives a large tray that turns out to hold only one tiny bite of food. He eats the single morsel in one spoonful, mutters 'that's it?', and stands in the street with the empty tray and a deflated face.

A young woman waits at airport arrivals clutching yellow flowers, and when a man pushes his luggage trolley through the doors she covers her mouth and bursts into tears. She runs to him and they hug tightly, both laughing and crying at once.

A young woman stuck on a crowded bus with a rusty old handlebar across her lap stares out the window at a cyclist gliding past on a nice bike. She sighs 'I want that', presses her hand against the glass and slumps back with a long envious look.

A young man knocks a clay jug and finds a long crack in it; he nervously puts it back on the shelf and glances around, then sits in front of his plate of rice unable to eat, rubbing his face and finally hiding it in both hands as he admits he broke it.

In a ballet studio a dancer performs confidently, but the teacher pins the red prize ribbon on another girl; the dancer claps stiffly, mutters, crosses her arms and glares with an exaggerated envious scowl.

A young woman in linen pajamas steps onto a tropical veranda at sunrise, sets a mug of coffee on a stool, settles into a rope hammock among palm trees and relaxes with closed eyes while an orange cat climbs onto her lap.

A woman mechanic in overalls wheels a vintage motorcycle she has restored out of her garage onto a sunlit cobbled street and polishes its silver tank. Neighbours gather around admiring it while she stands tall beside the bike, crosses her arms and beams, saying "There! I did that."

A driver grips the steering wheel with a tense, worried face through a tricky parking moment; when it is over she gasps, breathes 'phew', covers her face with both hands and melts into relieved laughter.

A hand-drawn cartoon on a grey background. A girl with long dark hair kneels holding a sheet of paper marked with a big red A+. Her face crumples, her mouth turns down and two thick turquoise streams of tears run from her eyes. She throws her head back and wails with her mouth wide open while the tears gush out in great arcs on both sides of her head and pool on the ground around her knees, until she is kneeling in a spreading puddle of her own crying, still holding the paper. The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.

A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

A footballer in a green shirt stands in a floodlit stadium, her face wet with tears and her mouth open as she sings. Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.

A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.

Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.

Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.
